name: Incline Push-Up

instructions.description: Place hands on a stable bench slightly wider than shoulder width.
Step back and align the trunk comfortably from head to heels.
Lower the chest toward the bench by bending the elbows.
Press back to the start while keeping the trunk controlled.

variations.variationDescription: Wall Push-Up provides a meaningfully different loading, support, or stability option compared with Incline Push-Up.
Standard Push-Up meaningfully changes the difficulty, loading, support, or movement demands compared with Incline Push-Up.
Incline Push-Up — Tempo-Controlled Version: Use a deliberately slower lowering phase without creating a separate database record.
Incline Push-Up — Reduced-Range Version: Use a smaller comfortable range while preserving the same movement pattern.

commentsNotes: Use a stable surface that will not move.
